atq.text: Tawnos was born in Jorilin, where his interest in artifacts estranged him from his uncles, and after Urza became Chief Artificer he left for Kroog. There he lures Urza from his work with a snake toy and becomes his apprentice, and after creating clay warriors he is promoted to master.

During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and she helps them escape by boat. At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza, and Tawnos survives the blast sealed in the Stasis Coffin until Urza releases him five years later.

Six years after the war Urza returns to say farewell to Tawnos and asks him to return to Kayla. Tawnos helps Kayla defend Penregon against the Church of Tal's siege, then destroys Urza's archives and leaves, ending the age of artifice in Penregon, and he and Ashnod later found the Conclave of Mages near Ronom Lake.

bro.text: Tawnos, frostbitten and aged, arrives for a private meeting with Kayla, who tells him she thought he was dead, and he reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else. Kayla still tells him she will never forgive him for convincing her to let her son Harbin go off and die in her husband's war.

He shows Kayla Urza's designs, says he has recovered powerstones, and offers to build tools to rebuild Penregon, and when a ragged march of ten thousand approaches, Kayla orders him to arm the civils. In his factory he realizes the civils were built from Urza's war machines and that Penregon's powerstones will run out, making war inevitable.
Tawnos then tears pages of his toy designs from his notebook and sets fire to his office, and Kayla concludes that he set the fire himself and vanished.

At the last battle on Argoth, Ashnod tells Tawnos to get the sylex to Urza at any cost, and he brings it to him with the message to fill it with his memories of the land. Afterward Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and sends him west to teach, then fades away as Tawnos walks inland while snow begins to fall.
